headline: Trilegal, TT&A, Hogan Lovells Cadwalader act on Dosti Realty proposed IPO
sum: Dosti Realty Limited has filed confidential draft red herring prospectus for an initial public offering of its equity shares of face value of INR 5 each comprising a fresh issue and an offer for sale. Trilegal is advising Dosti Realty on…
detail: Dosti Realty Limited has filed confidential draft red herring prospectus for an initial public offering of its equity shares of face value of INR 5 each comprising a fresh issue and an offer for sale. Trilegal is advising Dosti Realty on this IPO. The transaction is being led by Albin Thomas (Partner), with support from Arsh Sinha (Senior Associate) and Associates Snehal Kaushal, Anand Kumar, Mohak Agarwal and Rishab Taori. Albin George Thomas TT&A is advising JM Financial Limited, Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors Limited and ITI Capital Limited, the book running lead managers acting on this IPO.
